sources.title: Transliteration Keyboard for Mixed-Language Text | UnimeType
sources.snippet: UnimeType is a transliteration keyboard for Pinyin, Romaji, Romanized Hindi, and Arabizi. Finish the draft, then choose Convert—without switching layouts.

sources.title: AI Keyboard Translator for Mixed-Language Typing | UnimeType
sources.snippet: AI keyboard translator An AI keyboard translator for mixed-language messages UnimeType lets you finish a message on one Latin-character keyboard and then choose Convert. The action changes transliterated spans that match your enabled input-language rules while recognized English and protected values remain in place.
